description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act No. 28 of 1961 - Order under Section 66
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the revision of fuel prices under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961. The Minister is exercising powers granted by this specific legislation to issue a regulatory order. The content focuses on establishing new regulatory pricing standards for petroleum products, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
